trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: 1) Perform 250 stunt moves - jumps, drifts, near-miss chains and other scored driving and riding tricks all count toward the PSN target of 250. 2) Farm them on the coastal highway and stunt ramps rather than in traffic; repeatable ramps are the fastest loop. 3) Bursts of about 25 a session keep the grind painless; the counter on this card tracks you.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: 1) Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: PSN counts types tried, not completions. 2) One attempt is enough per type - a single race, range challenge, fishing contest, arcade cabinet and so on. 3) Tick types off as you tour Leonida; most sit on the map as activity icons once discovered.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: 1) Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges; PSN tracks the 42 challenges. 2) Learn each weapon class's gold score on its easiest range first, then carry the technique to the harder bays. 3) Replay freely - only your best medal per challenge counts, and medals never downgrade. 4) Save the moving-target and low-ammo challenges for last; they are the usual roadblocks.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: 1) With your partner alongside, raise a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose it completely and escape. 2) Both of you must stay together until the stars clear - splitting up early can void the escape. 3) Tunnels, alley swaps and a vehicle change are the reliable way to break line of sight at 4 stars.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: 1) Knock someone down with a melee drive-by - strike a pedestrian from a moving vehicle with a melee swing. 2) A slow pass on a motorcycle gives the cleanest swing. 3) It only needs the knockdown, not a kill.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: 1) Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. 2) Marked Bills come from robberies; route them through the laundering contacts Chapter 2 introduces rather than spending them raw. 3) The counter is in dollars laundered, not bills - big scores move it fastest.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: 1) Spend $100,000 across all shops. 2) Everything counts - vehicles, clothes, weapons and property services. 3) Do not hoard for it: normal play crosses six figures well before the endgame.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: 1) Purchase all 8 garage properties. 2) Garages unlock for purchase as districts open; buy them as you pass rather than in one tour. 3) You need the cash, not the cars - empty garages still count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: 1) Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. 2) Register each new vehicle you keep as you acquire it - ten registrations accumulate quickly. 3) Duplicates of the same model may not add; register distinct vehicles.
